in_marathi.name: Bhupat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhupat is a Sanskrit name derived from the roots 'bhu' meaning earth and 'pat' meaning master or ruler. The name signifies the one who rules over the earth. In Hindu mythology, Bhupat is a title of various gods and goddesses, including Lord Vishnu, Lord Shiva, and Goddess Durga.
